en.summary: Obstructive sleep apnoea causes pauses in breathing during sleep, loud snoring, daytime sleepiness and concentration problems. NHS: GP/sleep clinic pathways; CPAP and lifestyle measures are clinician-led — never invent device settings or drug doses. Emergency: severe breathlessness while awake, chest pain, or blue lips — use cardio/respiratory pathways.
emergencyIf: Severe breathlessness at rest while awake
doNot: Do not invent CPAP pressure settings or stimulant doses
Do not drive if dangerously sleepy

fr.summary: Apnée du sommeil: pauses, ronflement, somnolence. Orientation NHS; pas de réglages PPC inventés. Urgences si dyspnée éveillée sévère.

he.summary: דום נשימה בשינה: הפסקות, נחירות, ישנוניות. לפי NHS; אין הגדרות CPAP מומצאות. חירום בקוצר נשימה בערות.

ru.summary: Апноэ сна: паузы, храп, сонливость. Ориентир NHS; настройки СИПАП не выдумывать. Неотложка при тяжёлой одышке наяву.
